items.title: Breaking Benjamin Frontman Begs Concertgoers To Download His Fallout 4 Mod He Got Bullied Over
items.summary: Benjamin Burnley, frontman of the Pennsylvania active rock staples Breaking Benjamin, would really, really, like you to download his Fallout 4 mod. It would mean a lot to him. On Saturday night, Breaking Benjamin played a headlining gig at the PNC Bank Arts Center in Holmdel, New Jersey. During the show, drummer Brian Medeiros broke a snare, and a drum tech had to come up to help him fix it. That meant that the band had some dead time onstage, and Burnley used more than five minutes to give the crowd a speech about his Fallout 4 mod.
